///////////////////////////////
marker $$ test fujinet init $$
///////////////////////////////


; load fujinet rom
memory load rom #0x8000 "${WS_ROOT}/build/fujinet.rom"
symbols load "${WS_ROOT}/build/fujinet.rom.lbl"

; load in the harness which sets up MOS stubs, and various vectors
memory load atari "${BINARY_PATH}"
symbols load "${SYMBOLS_PATH}"

; remove any cc65 autogenerated symbols from the ROM
symbols remove "__.*"

; mark the ROM as read only
memory protect ro #0xFF00 0x0100

; clean start
registers flush

; initialise the ROM
run $init_harness until (CP = $end_init_harness OR cycle_count > 5000)
assert CP = $end_init_harness $$completed code correctly$$
assert cycle_count <= 1800    $$cycles within accpeptable limit from previous runs$$

; check the vectors were setup
memory show #0x0210 0x10

; check each vector is correct
assert #0x0212 -> #0xFF1B       $$FILEV set$$
assert #0x0214 -> #0xFF1E       $$ARGSV set$$
assert #0x0216 -> #0xFF21       $$BGETV set$$
assert #0x0218 -> #0xFF24       $$BPUTV set$$
assert #0x021A -> #0xFF27       $$GBPBV set$$
assert #0x021C -> #0xFF2A       $$FINDV set$$
assert #0x021E -> #0xFF2D       $$FSCV  set$$

; check extended vectors went into correct locations
; These are 3 bytes groups; <vector low>, <vector hi>, <rom number>
memory show #0x0DBA 0x15

; starts at $0DBA ($0D9F + 1B), not sure why the offset yet
assert #0x0DBA -> $filev_entry  $$filev_entry$$
assert #0x0DBC = 0x0E           $$ROM E$$
assert #0x0DBD -> $argsv_entry  $$argsv_entry$$
assert #0x0DBF = 0x0E           $$ROM E$$
assert #0x0DC0 -> $bgetv_entry  $$bgetv_entry$$
assert #0x0DC2 = 0x0E           $$ROM E$$
assert #0x0DC3 -> $bputv_entry  $$bputv_entry$$
assert #0x0DC5 = 0x0E           $$ROM E$$
assert #0x0DC6 -> $gbpbv_entry  $$gbpbv_entry$$
assert #0x0DC8 = 0x0E           $$ROM E$$
assert #0x0DC9 -> $findv_entry  $$findv_entry$$
assert #0x0DCB = 0x0E           $$ROM E$$
assert #0x0DCC -> $fscv_entry   $$fscv_entry$$
assert #0x0DCE = 0x0E           $$ROM E$$
